Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: polished GitHub README product illustration, landscape 16:9.
Transform the supplied Recollect UI concepts into a fresh editorial product visual. Image 1 is the approved private-runner concept; image 2 is the approved compact tool-access concept. Preserve their visual identity, rather than their full page layout or example installation names.
Match Recollect exactly: flat warm cream canvas #f7f4ec; ivory paper #fffdf8; pale sage card headers #e8f0e9; dark ink #101b2a; restrained sage #3d6b59 accents; hairline warm-grey dividers. Elegant Newsreader-like serif page/card headings, Manrope-like compact sans-serif controls, DM Mono tool identifiers. Fine Lucide-style outline icons, small badges, quiet rounded corners, no heavy shadows. Crisp, exquisitely typeset, coherent real software components. Spacious overall composition, compact details, strong hierarchy, generous page margins.
This is an illustrative feature view for the README, not a complete settings screenshot. Make it feel like the approved product design presented by an excellent product designer. No generic flowchart boxes, no stock infographic templates, no neon/glow, no gradients, no 3D, no robots/brains-as-clipart, no photos, no giant icons, no customer names/UUIDs, no tiny explanatory paragraphs or invented extra copy. Use only the requested concise labels; text must be legible at README display size. Keep all elements aligned and safely inside the canvas.
Primary request: a beautiful agent-to-Brain product overview, using actual compact Recollect roster and knowledge-card language.
Top left small wordmark "Recollect." with the sage final dot. Main serif title "Connect once. Keep context." One quiet supporting line: "Codex · Claude Code · OpenCode".
Composition: an attractive central pair of paper app panels. Left panel title "Your agents", with three compact aligned agent rows named "Codex", "Claude Code", "OpenCode", each showing a small outline host glyph and a sage "Connected" badge. A minimal bottom row shows two small connection-kind pills "Plugin" and "Direct MCP". Right panel title "Engineering Brain" with subtle sage header; three beautifully spaced knowledge rows "Decisions", "Repository knowledge", "Session memory", with understated document/book/message icons. An inset recall snippet reads "Context for your next session" with a small "With evidence" badge. Join the panels with a thin sage connector labelled "Capture & recall"; keep it integrated and refined.
A slim lower product strip titled "Approved tools" shows three small MCP-style badges "Context7", "Exa", "Filesystem" and a compact "Tool access" affordance. Keep the focus on elegant product UI and continuing knowledge, not an infrastructure architecture diagram. This strip is visually separate because tools require independent grants. No additional long descriptions. Preserve the reference concepts' refined sage headers, text sizes, card density and icon stroke.

Small wordmark "Recollect." Main serif title "The right tools for each environment." Below: compact tabs "Connections", "Tool access", "Private Runners", with Tool access selected in sage and a fine underline.

Its header contains a small "Development" scope badge and an independent "1 MCP" badge; no giant edit fields.
The tool-group body has two restrained columns with a thin divider: "MCPs" on the left, showing an Exa row with "2 tools"; "People" on the right with one compact "Alex" avatar/name row. Use is green with a play icon; Manage and Share are pale red with settings/share outline icons. No duplicate effective/direct/inherited breakdowns. This is a Use-only reader.

Small wordmark "Recollect." Main serif title "Private tools. One connected workflow." A small upper caption reads "Plugin or direct MCP".
Composition: on the left, two compact tasteful product mini-panels, the upper labelled "Coding agent" with a restrained terminal/host icon; the lower labelled "Recollect" with a fine memory mark or simple circle glyph and the small caption "Access & dispatch". A thin line between them indicates the agent request and result. These panels occupy about 30 percent of the width and are subordinate to the runner card.

A tiny quiet footer caption says "Approved MCP tools, inside your network." 1. In the Coding agent card, REMOVE the three small chips reading "Claude", "Cursor", "etc.". In that same row show only the concise text "Plugin · Direct MCP" in the existing small sans-serif styling. Do not add any coding host names. Leave the "Coding agent" heading and its icon unchanged.
2. In the Recollect card, replace the invented script-like circular logo with a simple fine outline book icon consistent with the existing Tool groups book icon. Keep the card's heading "Recollect" and "Access & dispatch" unchanged.
Preserve every other element exactly. All tool identifiers and directional arrows must remain as in the supplied image. No additional text or changes.
